change: Prune already-excluded directory names before enumeration in repository secret scanning.
scope: Repository engineering overhead only; not a change to installed Skill rules or proof of model token/time benefit.

source.preserved: Ignored names, eligible-file filtering, global native Path ordering, suffixes, names, size bound, decoding, secret patterns and finding body remain unchanged.
source.failure_behavior: Unreadable eligible directories and unclassifiable entries now propagate OSError, as iteration/read failures do. They must not be reported as a clean scan. This deliberately tightens the old version-dependent rglob suppression behavior.

review.findings: Two silent OSError branches identified by four pure in-memory probes; both catches removed before final focused validation.
review.root_static_check: Other top-level function ASTs unchanged; final difference is pruning, os import and explicit error propagation.

validation.first_failure: The new test expected POSIX uppercase ordering on Windows. Detection set was correct; expected order now uses native Path sorting. Original failed result retained, not relabelled.
validation.skip: This host cannot create symbolic links. No symlink regression pass is claimed here.

limits: The 4.86s scan is one observed final-source local entry, not a matched speedup estimate. An earlier synthetic timing used an intermediate source and is not attributed to this final source. Cross-platform CI remains required for the new commit. No complete suite was rerun locally because focused affected behavior passed; CI supplies the matrix.
